tactics.label: hidden_ad
tactics.evidence: use the code "thebrilliantbeauty" to get 12% off
tactics.reason: A discount code means the creator earns when you buy. The video never says it is an ad.

tactics.label: body_image_pressure
tactics.reason: A number and a deadline make your body sound like a problem with a quick fix.

reality_check: "Detox" tea is mostly a laxative. Doctors say your liver and kidneys already do the job; the weight that drops is water.
